test_concat_sorts_columns: test pd.concat sorts DataFrame columns alphabetically when sort=True or sort=False
test_concat_sorts_index: test pd.concat sorts DataFrame index values when sort=True or sort=False with axis=1
test_concat_inner_sort: test pd.concat with join=inner respects sort parameter without warning on unset sort
test_concat_aligned_sort: test pd.concat with sort=True reorders columns alphabetically on aligned DataFrames
test_concat_sort_none_raises: test pd.concat raises ValueError when sort=None is passed
